title: Unbeatable cameras and natural color science

title: Battery life is just average, requires evening top-up
text: While performance is snappy, the battery barely lasts 5 hours of screen time. You definitely need to carry a power bank or charger if you use navigation.

title: Stays completely cool during heavy gaming
text: Thermally efficient vapor chamber cooling! Played Call of Duty Mobile for 45 minutes and the phone remained barely warm. No thermal throttling.

title: Incredible value for money flagship killer
text: Half the price of competing flagships with 90% of the features. Clean software with zero bloatware apps and guaranteed 5 years of security updates.

title: Screen peak brightness is underwhelming in direct sun
text: The OLED panel is sharp indoors, but difficult to read under intense afternoon sunlight. Viewing angles have a slight blue tint when tilted.

title: Solid tactile aluminum frame, survive drops
text: Dropped it onto a concrete sidewalk without a case and only suffered a tiny cosmetic dent on the corner. Built like a tank.

title: Slow 20W charging speed in 2026 is painful
